# Skyline Engineering

> Construction company based in Finestrat, Alicante, specialising in turnkey construction of private houses and villas in Benidorm, Finestrat and the surrounding Costa Blanca. Plot assistance, architecture, permits, construction, engineering and finishing under one coordinated process — from land analysis to handover.

Skyline Engineering (legal name: SKYLINE ENGINEERING, S.L.) is a construction company registered and based in Finestrat, Alicante. It builds turnkey private houses and villas in Benidorm — its main commercial service area — and across the surrounding Costa Blanca: Finestrat, La Nucía, Polop, L'Alfàs del Pi, Altea, Altea Hills, Calpe, Benissa, Moraira, Jávea. Founded and led by Denys Druz (Architect · Civil Engineer, 25+ years of experience in construction and engineering design).

## Services

Plot assistance and feasibility review, architecture and design coordination, building licence, construction, engineering systems, finishing, pool and landscaping, technical supervision and project management, handover.
